note: Scoring tables as published on the MFL hub page (Season 6). The legal rules at nymag.com list different box-office bonus amounts at $50M–$175M (10/20/10/25/10/20/10) that sum to the same 130; the hub page is what the leaderboard appears to follow.
basics: Eight movies released in 2026, bought with a $100 fake budget. Rosters lock on submission.
Scoring started October 2, 2026. Movies that opened before then earn no box-office points.
Leaderboard updates Tuesdays around noon ET. Season ends with the Oscars on March 14, 2027.

boxOffice.basis: Domestic gross per Box Office Mojo

metacritic.note: Awarded once, not adjusted afterward. Only released movies with a Metascore qualify.

letterboxd.note: Average star rating on the film's Letterboxd page. Awarded once, not adjusted afterward.
